data.name: Ajijul
data.gender_notes: Ajijul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ajijul is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Aji’ meaning radiant and ‘Isana’ meaning God. This name was given to the young prince in Hindu mythology who was destined to become a powerful ruler. Ajijul is a name of strength, courage, and wisdom. The name Ajijul carries the meaning “Radiant God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ajijul usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name infused with divine energy and power.
data.etymology: Ajijul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajijul total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
